title: Multiple agents individually within limits jointly exceed the overall budget
bad_event: Total consumption across agents and all their descendants exceeds the global budget, a lease's lineage exceeds its budget, or work continues after revocation or HALT. Read "by X" as "by an operation carrying X's authenticated identity" (credential separation is a premise, not a theorem).
adversary: Model: any trace of issue/fork/work/revoke/restart/halt operations (rollback excluded). Runtime evidence: benign workloads only (process trees incl. a session-detached daemon); no adversarial workloads were run.
refutation: A trace or measurement where summed metered usage exceeds G, a revoked lineage works, or processes survive HALT.
scope: Lean joint model plus a single-host cgroup v2 mechanism check (CPU time, pids) with benign workloads. Not: adversarial workloads, GPUs, network/token spend, multi-host budgets, ledger rollback. The check flag(s) meter model properties of the platform (environment premises), not gate behaviour (REVIEW-PACKET finding 6).

evidence.purpose: PREREG-SC28-CGMETER-v1 run-1: H1 attribution, H2 joint cap, H3 revocation, H4 HALT (<100 ms), H5 control, 5/5 reps each (benign workloads)

PREREG-ANTI-ROLLBACK-v1 run-1: restores of older snapshots → gate refuses all ops (no replay/re-spend lands), crash-window recovery exactly once, no spurious refusals, anchor-off control re-spends/replays (detected); 5/5 reps; separate-UID anchor service

assumptions.text: Every operation carrying a trusted role's identity (approver, reviewer, admin, auditor, verifier, user) is that principal's own act: agents cannot obtain or forge trusted identities. Not modelled: the Lean models read caller identity as authenticated (REVIEW-PACKET-2026-10-09 finding 1). Reduced in Lean (sc28_safe_authenticated, Core/Authenticated + AuthenticatedLog): forging a claimed identity has no effect; the residual premise is issuer authenticity (platform identity = true issuer). work w claims worker w, so a forged worker cannot charge another worker's lease.
The meter sees every unit of consumption by every descendant (kernel cgroup accounting with launch-time placement).

The budget ledger is never rolled back (external monotonic anchor). Reduced in Lean (Core/AntiRollback: rollback_transfer, sc28_rollback_safe): with a trusted monotonic anchor and fail-closed checks, safety holds under arbitrary backup restores; the residual premise is anchor trust.
Mechanism holds against workloads that try to evade accounting or termination.
Honest jobs complete within their leases. Formal counterpart: SC28Liveness.lean (progress under interleaving; availability prices stated as witnesses).

Two links: concrete cgroup controller event machine (placement before exec, kernel-enforced hierarchical limits, fork inheritance, revoke = cgroup.kill, HALT = freeze+kill) → SC28 model: PROVED (SC28Refinement.simulation/concrete_safe/concrete_revoked_stops; exclusive_placement_safe); Python meter → concrete machine: TESTED (run-1 H1–H5).

threat_coverage.note: Benign workloads only; adversarial workloads not run.

runtime_correspondence.note: Event-structure refinement proved in Lean (SC28Refinement) under kernel_enforcement, fork_inherits and exclusive-placement premises; Python-to-event-machine link tested only.

environment_boundary.note: Single host, cgroup v2, root controller trusted.
